title: SupportPanel
wrapsNative: sheet(isPresented:) with presentationDetents([.medium, .large]) holding a NavigationStack with a segmented Picker for Chat and Help; Chat is a ScrollView of MonarchMessageRow with MonarchMessageComposer in safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom); Help is a List with Sections of article Buttons, Link rows and MonarchStatusDot, with searchable(text:prompt:)
summary: A recipe, not a component: help and support in a sheet, with a chat with support, help articles, contact options and the service status.
whenToUse: Behind a Help & support button or menu item, in products that offer in-app support chat or help articles.
whenNotToUse: For a full help site use the help-center-home recipe in a navigation stack. For one message to the team use a mailto Link or ShareLink. For the assistant of the product use MonarchAiConversation.
api: .sheet(isPresented: $showsSupport) { NavigationStack { Picker("Section", selection:) { … }.pickerStyle(.segmented); chat or help }.navigationTitle("Help & support") }.presentationDetents([.medium, .large])

Help: List { Section("Popular articles") { Button or NavigationLink }; Section("Contact us") { Link(destination:) { Label(_:systemImage:) } }; Section("Status") { MonarchStatusDot(_:tone:); Link(_:destination:).buttonStyle(.monarchLink(.standalone, isExternal: true)) } }.searchable(text:prompt:)
MonarchSearchResults(groups:query:onSelect:) in place of the article list while a search is typed

states.name: chat
states.description: The support conversation with the composer pinned above the keyboard.

states.name: help
states.description: Popular articles, contact options and the status, searchable.

states.name: searching
states.description: Show MonarchSearchResults for the query in place of the sections.

states.name: connecting or offline
states.description: Show MonarchLoadingState while the chat client connects and MonarchErrorState with a retry when it fails; disable the composer with disabledReason.

states.name: status
states.description: MonarchStatusDot with a tone and a word, such as "All systems normal" (success) or "Degraded performance" (warning).

appearance: The system sheet with the theme's surface, a segmented control, Monarch message rows and composer, the system list with Monarch links and a status dot in its tone. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web SupportPanel is a side sheet beside the app rail with Chat and Help tabs, driven by the product's Support Chat API client, and it filters link schemes. On iOS it is a recipe: the system sheet with medium and large detents and a navigation bar, a segmented Picker for the two tabs, and the app's own chat client feeding MonarchMessageRow and MonarchMessageComposer. Links open with the system (mailto:, tel:, https:) through Link, so no scheme filtering is needed. The web's connect timeout and own chat surface are the app's concern. Android composes the same recipe in a modal bottom sheet.
accessibility: The sheet has a navigation title, read as a header, and a Done button.
The segmented Picker is read as a tab-like control with its selected value.
Each message is read as its author, time and text (MonarchMessageRow); new messages should be announced by the app.
Contact options are links with a label and icon; the status is a dot with a word, not only a colour.
Every control is at least 44 points.
edgeCases: Keep the conversation in the app's model so it survives closing the sheet, as the web keeps it.
A large detent keeps the composer above the keyboard; the medium detent suits the Help tab.
Hide the Chat tab when the product has no support chat; the Help tab stands alone.
